lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (α : Type) (A B C D : Set α) (ab : A ⊆ B) (bc : B ⊆ C) (cd : C ⊆ D) : A ∩ B ⊆ D := by
  intro h0
  intro h1
  apply cd
  apply bc
  exact h1.2

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
